sj43515ts_candidate_geometry.coordinate_frame: Manufacturer PCB TOP VIEW. Origin is Connector Edge datum intersecting plug axis. X increases from mouth toward connector rear; Y increases toward pins 1/4/2. This is not the courtyard centre or old U83 anchor.
sj43515ts_candidate_geometry.body_envelope_note: Conservative nominal union from dimensioned views, not an exact stepped body or STEP. A negative-X nose is the entry, not an extra requirement for a PCB notch.

sj43515ts_candidate_geometry.derived_pad_datums: The 10.0 mm outer land-row span and 3.0 mm land height give Y=+/-3.5. Pad5 has its 3.0 mm dimension along X; its outer X18.5 gives centre X17.0. Its centre is Y=-0.80. No dimensions are taken from image pixels.
sj43515ts_candidate_geometry.locator_assessment: On the present 1.60 +/-0.16 mm finished PCB model, the 0.95 +/-0.25 mm locator does not protrude onto the opposite RF exterior surface. Both NPTHs still require through-board copper/mask and opposite-side component clearance checks.
sj43515ts_candidate_geometry.edge_pose_constraint: A board edge at the drawing Connector Edge X0 would clip pad1, whose copper reaches X=-0.4. Put the board edge at X<=-0.4 minus the required factory copper-to-edge allowance. Keeping the nose beyond that edge avoids crediting a hidden under-body cutout; exact native pose is not chosen here.
